Rules: Emperor Edition core rules; reviewed period printings; issue #738.

Cards.Name: Drain of Effort
Cards.Text:
Open: Until this phase ends or a player has discarded two cards from this effect, after each action other than this one resolves, its player discards a card.
Open: Draw a card.

Cards.Name: Suck the Marrow
Cards.Text: Open: Bow and destroy your performing Shugenja and target a Personality: Give the target a -1F/-1C Poison token. Lose 3 Honor. Until the game ends, after each Events Phase begins, give the target a -1F/-1C Poison token.

Cards.Name: Temple Grounds
Cards.Text:
If you do not control a Cavalry unit here, negate each Battle action taken by a player without units here.
Battle/Engage: Destroy a Terrain (if able). Put this Terrain into play.
